title: Product reviews
seoTitle: Shopify review apps compared: real monthly cost by order volume
lede: Collect and display reviews. Pricing mostly depends on monthly orders.
watch: Free plans are generous here. Pay only for what you would use: video reviews, AI summaries, syndication to Google and Meta.
metaTitle: Shopify review apps: real monthly cost compared

title: Email marketing
seoTitle: Shopify email marketing apps compared: real monthly cost by list size
lede: Campaigns and automated flows. Pricing depends on contacts and email volume.
watch: Most email apps publish only a starting price: the bill rises with your list size.
metaTitle: Shopify email apps: real monthly cost compared

title: Subscriptions
seoTitle: Shopify subscription apps compared: real monthly cost incl. transaction fees
lede: Recurring orders. Pricing depends on subscribers, and sometimes a fee on every renewal.
watch: A transaction fee on renewals can cost more than the monthly plan once you pass a few hundred subscribers.
scenarioNote: Assumes one renewal per subscriber per month at a $45 average order.
metaTitle: Shopify subscription apps: real cost incl. fees

title: Translation
seoTitle: Shopify translation apps compared: real monthly cost by words and languages
lede: Sell in more languages. Pricing depends on words translated, the number of languages and, for some apps, the number of products.
watch: Word limits usually count every translated word, so 10,000 words in 2 languages uses 20,000.
metaTitle: Shopify translation apps: real monthly cost compared

title: Loyalty & rewards
seoTitle: Shopify loyalty apps compared: real monthly cost by order volume
metaTitle: Shopify loyalty apps: real monthly cost compared
lede: Points, rewards, referrals and VIP tiers. Pricing depends on monthly orders.
watch: Several loyalty apps charge per extra 100 orders above an included amount: the bill keeps rising with your volume.

title: Upsell & bundles
seoTitle: Shopify upsell apps compared: real monthly cost by orders and upsell revenue
metaTitle: Shopify upsell apps: real monthly cost compared
lede: Post-purchase offers, bundles and cross-sells. Pricing depends on orders or on the upsell revenue the app brings in.
watch: Some apps price by orders, others by upsell revenue: compare them at your own numbers, not at their starting price.
scenarioNote: Upsell revenue is the extra revenue the app's offers generate each month.

title: Page builders
seoTitle: Shopify page builder apps compared: real monthly cost by published pages
metaTitle: Shopify page builder apps: real monthly cost compared
lede: Landing pages, product pages and sections without code. Pricing depends on how many pages you publish.
watch: Free plans publish one page at most: count the pages you will keep live, not the ones you will draft.

title: SEO
seoTitle: Shopify SEO apps compared: every plan and price
metaTitle: Shopify SEO apps: every plan and price compared
lede: Meta tags, schema, image compression and audits. Pricing depends on features, not on your store's volume.
watch: SEO apps sell features, not capacity: start on a free or entry plan and upgrade only for a feature you will use.
